why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Brandon Marsh is slot #3 (4.938 expected team runs/game).
Slots #3, #2, #4, #5, #6, #1, #7, #9, #8 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #4 ranks 3 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.001 R/G.
Slot #3 yields 4.53 expected PA/game vs 4.42 at primary slot #4. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
